Product Manager — Card Activation, London hybrid.

Brightcard (London, 300 people, Series C) builds a debit and credit-builder card. We're hiring a mid-level Product Manager with 3+ years' experience to own one squad's activation backlog — card ordering, first-transaction nudges and in-app onboarding — reporting to a Senior PM. Hybrid, three days a week. This is an individual-contributor role with a well-defined scope; strategy is set by the Group PM.

label_v2.edge_note: two levels below the target titles; Series C, no growth signal stated → medium
